svg.title: Mature follow-up
svg.desc: Mature follow-up. Historical definition. 3- or 6-year windows after expected school completion; adjusted difference (pp). Nominal uncertainty interval: 95 %. Enrollment in at least 2 of 3 years: −3.1 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE; Undergraduate degree within 6 years: −1.5 pp; ESTIMABLE_DESCRIPTIVE.
